Pokémon Pokopia — Steam Deck Setup

Quick step-by-step installation instructions
1
Go to Desktop Mode
Press the STEAM button → Power → Switch to Desktop.
2
Extract the ROM
Put pokopia.rar in your Downloads folder and extract it.
3
Rename the folder
Rename the extracted folder PPP ROM to exactly: Pokopia
4
Copy the base folder
Copy the base folder from Downloads, go inside Pokopia, and paste it there. If asked to replace, choose Yes.
5
Copy the exefs folder
Go back to Downloads, copy the exefs folder, navigate to Pokopia/updates/655360, and paste it there. If asked to replace, choose Yes.
6
Make the installer executable
Right-click pokopia-deck-setup.sh → Properties → Permissions → check Is executable.
7
Run the installer
Double-click pokopia-deck-setup.sh and choose Run in Terminal. Let it finish.
8
Play in Gaming Mode
Double-click Return to Gaming Mode on the desktop. Open your Steam Library → Non-Steam → launch Pokopia.
Note:
On the very first launch, a window will pop up asking for your character name. Type your name, click OK, and the game will start. It remembers your name and will not ask again.
